search_products.description: Search Amazon US for a query in a price range, cheapest first; read every result card on up to max_pages pages (price, stock, delivery, rating, renewed, used & new from-price).

inputs.min/max: price range in USD (rh=p_36 in cents)

steps: search_via=form (default, as the user asked): bring the bound tab to the front; type_cdp the query into search_box (click, clear, insertText); check the box holds exactly the query; check search_submit is visible and uncovered (elementFromPoint); CDP-click search_submit.
Wait for a results page whose k= is the query, with result_card or no_results.
Apply sort + price range to that results URL (s=price-asc-rank, rh=p_36:<min*100>-<max*100>) and load it.
More pages: CDP-click next_page (uncovered), evidence = page=N in the URL; if the click doesn't move the page, open the link's href.
search_via=url: navigate straight to https://www.amazon.com/s?k=<query>&s=price-asc-rank&rh=p_36:...&page=<n> (works in a background tab).
Stop on captcha_form or a robot-check page.
Read result_card -> data-asin, card_title, card_price, card_list_price, card_delivery, card_secondary_offer, card_rating, card_reviews, card_prime (Prime badge).
Follow next_page until it is absent, a page adds nothing new, or max_pages.
search_products.evidence: Each card has an ASIN and a title; a price is either read or the card is marked no_offer / out_of_stock. The page URL keeps the query and range.

check_product.description: Open a product page and read what can actually be bought: the selected option's real price (variation menu), availability (buy button + availability line), new / used offer, Prime, delivery, seller. Read-only.

inputs.asin: product id from a search card

steps: Navigate the bound tab to https://www.amazon.com/dp/<asin> (after a human pause); wait for product_title; stop on a robot check.
Glance down the page (wheel; on product pages the debugger is refused, so it falls back to scrollBy). Reads go through chrome.scripting (extension capability script_fallback).

Read selected_variant (variant_label, variant_price, variant_availability, variant_prime), core_price, product_availability, add_to_cart / buy_now / add_to_cart_used / see_all_offers / out_of_stock presence, buybox_prime, delivery_block, merchant_info, product_asin.
Real price = variant_price of the option whose data-asin is the page ASIN, else core_price. Available = a buy button is present AND the availability line does not say unavailable / out of stock.
NEVER click add_to_cart or buy_now: their presence is the evidence.
check_product.evidence: product_asin equals the requested ASIN (a mismatch is noted); the result names availability, price, condition, Prime.
